tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text:
Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new client account opening package. Confirm account purpose, registration type, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete.

Open a new joint taxable advisory account for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz with transfer-on-death registration. Fund the account with cash above the household reserve target and anticipated estate cash once received. Reflect the couple’s moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and preference to avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared. Confirm the joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz, reflecting their moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and preference to avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow. Fund the account with cash above the household reserve target and anticipated estate cash once received.

tickets.evidence: Nolan asked to set up a new joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration for cash above the household reserve target and for anticipated estate cash once received.

tickets.title: Collect Benefits Enrollment Information
tickets.text:
Complete the following placeholders for benefits enrollment review:

Employee name: Lila Pebblefizz
Employer or plan sponsor: Moonbadger Design Studio
Enrollment period or qualifying event: New role beginning September 2024; enrollment window closing
Benefit year: [Benefit year]
Household members to consider: Lila Pebblefizz
Medical plan options available: [Medical plan options]
Dental and vision options: [Dental and vision options]
Health savings account or flexible spending account eligibility: [HSA/FSA eligibility]
Employer retirement plan contribution election: [Contribution election]
Employer match details: [Employer match details]
Life and disability insurance options: [Insurance options]
Key questions or tradeoffs: Side-by-side review of medical coverage, disability options, life insurance, HSA or FSA eligibility, and retirement plan contributions before the enrollment window closes.
Documents received: Employee portal screenshots provided by Nolan Pebblefizz during the meeting.
Recommended follow-up: Complete the benefits enrollment review by 2024-10-25.
tickets.evidence: Nolan provided the employee portal screenshots during the meeting and asked for a side-by-side review before her enrollment window closes. They agreed to complete the Moonbadger Design Studio benefits enrollment review by 2024-10-25.

tickets.title: Prepare Year-End Tax Projection and Charitable Funding Analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a year-end tax projection and charitable funding analysis for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz. Coordinate withholding, estimated tax exposure, appreciated-share giving, and whether a larger charitable gift should be made before year-end.
tickets.evidence: Nolan requested a projection that coordinates withholding, estimated tax exposure, appreciated-share giving, and whether a larger charitable gift should be made before year-end. They agreed to complete the year-end tax projection and charitable funding analysis by 2024-12-06.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text:
Collect the core facts needed to evaluate an inheritance event, including the expected asset types, estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Do not request sensitive account numbers unless required through secure channels.

Gather the core facts for Nolan Pebblefizz’s potential inheritance from Adele Pebblefizz’s estate, including the estimated $220,000 in cash, possible inherited IRA interest, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. The executor’s email references estate cash, a possible inherited IRA interest, and pending tax reporting, but the client file does not yet contain the estate inventory, beneficiary confirmation, inherited IRA custodian notice, or expected distribution schedule.
tickets.evidence: Nolan asked for the core facts to be gathered before any investment decision is made. They agreed to complete the inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate by 2024-10-30.

tickets.title: Reconcile Paper Otter Analytics Stock Basis
tickets.text: Reconcile the cost basis for Nolan Pebblefizz’s Paper Otter Analytics tax lots in his spreadsheet with the figures appearing on the Velvet Acorn Custody unrealized gain report. Resolve the discrepancy to inform which shares may be suitable for charitable gifting or trimming as part of the concentration-management discussion.
tickets.evidence: Nolan’s spreadsheet shows a different cost basis for several Paper Otter Analytics tax lots than the figures appearing on the Velvet Acorn Custody unrealized gain report.

tickets.title: Confirm Velvet Acorn Custody Portal Records and Account Settings
tickets.text: Confirm current records in the Velvet Acorn Custody portal for the household login that still shows paper delivery. Verify the beneficiary update Nolan believed was submitted for his IRA and correct account-level settings where needed.
tickets.evidence: Nolan also reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody portal still shows paper delivery for one household login and does not display the beneficiary update he believed was submitted for his IRA.

tickets.title: Prepare Estate Document Coordination Points
tickets.text: Prepare coordination points for the estate attorney to review Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz’s estate documents in light of the current family situation. Address the outdated guardianship provisions created when both children were minors and the successor trustee who has since moved overseas.
tickets.evidence: Nolan asked for coordination points to send to the estate attorney so the documents can be reviewed in light of the current family situation. They agreed to prepare the estate document coordination points by 2024-11-15.
